description: Record a bank payment in Billy to mark an invoice or bill as (partially) paid. Creates a bankPayment associated with the subject via 'invoice:<id>' or 'bill:<id>'. For invoices money is deposited (debit); for bills it is withdrawn (credit). WARNING: this posts a real accounting transaction.

cashAccountId.description: Bank account ID (must have isPaymentEnabled=true; see list_accounts)

cashAmount.description: Amount deposited/withdrawn in the cash account's currency

cashExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate: 1 subjectCurrency = cashExchangeRate cashAccountCurrency. Required when the cash account's currency differs from the invoice/bill currency.

cashSide.description: Override side: 'debit'=deposit (invoices), 'credit'=withdrawal (bills). Defaults based on subjectType.

feeAccountId.description: Expense account for the fee (required when feeAmount set)

subjectId.description: ID of the invoice or bill being paid

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

name: create_bank_payment
